scale: Answers run from -2 (strongly disagree) to +2 (strongly agree). agreeLeans: -1 = agreeing is the more left-leaning answer, +1 = more right-leaning, 0 = doesn't map cleanly onto left/right and is not counted.

issues.title: Healthcare
issues.statement: The government should guarantee health insurance for everyone.

issues.title: Taxes & the economy
issues.statement: Taxes on high earners and corporations should be raised to fund public services.

issues.title: Immigration
issues.statement: Border enforcement should be strengthened, even if it means fewer people can immigrate legally.

issues.title: Abortion
issues.statement: Abortion should be legal in most or all cases.

issues.title: Gun policy
issues.statement: Laws protecting the right to own firearms should be strengthened rather than restricted.

issues.title: Climate & energy
issues.statement: Government should require a faster shift to clean energy, even if energy costs rise in the short term.

issues.title: Schools
issues.statement: Families should receive public funding to send their children to private or charter schools.

issues.title: Crime & policing
issues.statement: Police funding should increase and sentences for violent crime should be tougher.

issues.title: Housing costs
issues.statement: Cities should loosen zoning rules to allow more homes to be built, even if neighborhoods change.

issues.title: Voting rules
issues.statement: Voters should be required to show photo ID to vote.

issues.title: Foreign policy
issues.statement: The U.S. should increase military and financial support for its allies abroad.

issues.title: Social Security & Medicare
issues.statement: Social Security and Medicare benefits should be protected from cuts, even if that means higher taxes.

issues.title: Business regulation
issues.statement: Government regulation of business does more harm than good.

issues.title: Death penalty
issues.statement: The death penalty should be a legal punishment for the most serious crimes.

issues.title: Trade & tariffs
issues.statement: Tariffs on imported goods are a good way to protect American jobs.

issues.title: Student debt
issues.statement: The federal government should cancel some student loan debt.

issues.title: Gender & schools
issues.statement: Schools should limit classroom discussion of gender identity and sexuality.

issues.title: Religion & government
issues.statement: Religious values should play a larger role in shaping public policy.

issues.title: Marijuana
issues.statement: Marijuana should be legal for adult recreational use nationwide.

issues.title: Assistance programs
issues.statement: Government assistance programs for low-income people should be expanded.
